title: Custom Dialogue Tool
subtitle: Unity Tool | Dialogue System | Custom Editor
content: Unity Tool | Dialogue System | Custom Editor
summary: Created a custom Unity node editor for branching dialogue, ScriptableObject data, and JSON export.
description: Designed and developed a custom Unity Editor tool for creating branching dialogue and conversations that can be played directly in-game. Each message stores a speaker, text, unique ID, and dialogue options, with drag-and-drop node connections to form dialogue trees.

highlights.name: Dialogue System + UI
highlights.detail: A dialogue system branching different dialogue options.

highlights.name: Node Editor
highlights.detail: Create, edit, move, delete, and connect nodes through a visual workflow.

highlights.name: Scriptable Objects
highlights.detail: Creates ScriptableObjects for each dialogue tree so data can be reused and edited inside Unity.

highlights.name: JSON Support
highlights.detail: Exports dialogue data to JSON so content can also be inspected or edited outside the engine.

roles: Designed and developed as a solo project
Designed the tool's features, node architecture, and dialogue data structure
Planned and tracked tasks using Confluence and JIRA
details: Designed and developed a custom Unity Editor tool for creating branching dialogue and conversations that can be played directly in-game. Each message stores a speaker, text, unique ID, and dialogue options. Users can drag connections between nodes to form a dialogue tree. The tool supports ScriptableObject creation for each dialogue tree and provides JSON export support.
